user.title: User details
user.blurb: As it appears on the PM Surya Ghar application.

isDcr.label: Going with DCR?
isDcr.hint: Domestic content modules. Switches on the stage 5 certificate step.

wantsSubsidy.label: Applying for subsidy?
wantsSubsidy.hint: Opens stage 9 settlement and the post-subsidy payment milestone.

rooftop.title: Rooftop details
rooftop.blurb: Plant size drives the load check, so get it right before the bill section.

aadhaar.title: Aadhaar details
aadhaar.blurb: Only the name and address as printed on the card — the number itself is not collected.

AADHAAR.label: Aadhaar card
AADHAAR.hint: Both sides · stored under a restricted prefix, every read logged

pan.title: PAN details
pan.blurb: One of the four names the flag engine compares.

bank.title: Bank details
bank.blurb: Where the subsidy lands — it is credited to the customer, not to BHIM.

confirmAccountNumber.label: Confirm account number
confirmAccountNumber.hint: Re-type it — this catches a mistyped digit before it reaches the bank file.

occupation.label: Occupation
occupation.hint: The lender wants this on the loan file.

hasCoApplicant.label: Co-applicant on the loan?
hasCoApplicant.hint: Optional. Saying yes adds a section for their details and documents.

CANCELLED_CHEQUE.label: Cancelled cheque
CANCELLED_CHEQUE.hint: Goes into the bank loan pack

BANK_STATEMENT.label: Bank statement
BANK_STATEMENT.hint: Last six months · for the loan file

PASSBOOK.label: Passbook photo
PASSBOOK.hint: Alternative if there is no cheque book

bank.uploadsNote: A cancelled cheque and a statement both go into the bank loan pack. A passbook photo stands in where the customer has no cheque book.

electricity.title: Electricity bill details
electricity.blurb: Taken from the latest bill for this connection.

nameOnBill.label: Name on the bill
nameOnBill.hint: Compared against Aadhaar, PAN and bank.

sanctionedLoadKw.label: Sanctioned load on the bill
sanctionedLoadKw.hint: Must be greater than the plant size, or a load enhancement is raised.

ELECTRICITY_BILL.label: Electricity bill
ELECTRICITY_BILL.hint: The latest bill for this connection

other.title: Other details
other.blurb: Equipment choices that carry through to the documents.

survey.title: Site survey
survey.blurb: Estimated runs. The actual lengths are recorded at stage 4.

coApplicant.title: Co-applicant
coApplicant.blurb: The bank wants the same identity set from them as from the consumer.

COAPP_PHOTO.label: Co-applicant photographs
COAPP_PHOTO.hint: Scan on file; the bank wants two prints attached by hand

coApplicant.uploadsNote: The same set the bank asks for from the main applicant. These join the bank file automatically.

stage1.note: Each section saves on its own
stage1.flagsOpen: {count, plural, one {# flag} other {# flags}} open.
stage1.cannotClose: Stage 1 cannot close until {what} is resolved.
stage1.aadhaarOnFile: Aadhaar on file, ending <ref>{masked}</ref>. No longer collected.
stage1.uploadCoAppFirst: Upload the co-applicant’s documents below before continuing.
stage1.uploadsDefaultNote: Uploaded at full resolution for printing, with a portal-sized copy made automatically.
